q: Dye's theorem (1959–1963) states that all free ergodic MPT actions of ℤ are:
opts: Weakly isomorphic but not orbit equivalent
Orbit equivalent only if they have the same entropy
exp: Dye: all free ergodic ℤ-actions are mutually orbit equivalent — there is only one orbit equivalence class for free ergodic ℤ-actions. Entropy, mixing, spectral type — none of this matters for orbit equivalence. The orbit structure is universal.
